Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
After making a cursory search on Google, I thought I'd throw this one
out.

I'm curious about the interaction between Clan Impersonation and Feral
Spirits, specifically, what is the result of:

1) Gangrel CI's to !Gangrel (or Gangrel, for that matter)
2) next turn has a Feral Spirit played on it -> now Ahrimanes
3) as its action on this next turn, burns the CI.

Is the vampire now:
a) Gangrel again, as the Feral Spirit was overlaying the !Gangrel CI
b) still Ahrimanes, as the Feral Spirit changed the clan again, and
the CI no longer has any noticeable effect
c) something else

I'm guessing b, but thought I'd ask. Just trying to figure out the
quickest way to make Bear Paw an Ahrimanes with SPI by using Feral
Spirit twice. Though I suppose

1) play Feral Spirit on Bear Paw
2) Ahrimanes with SPI plays Sanguine Instruction on Bear Paw

would be pretty fast. And I could always play the FS first, CI away,
and then FS again. Ah well, anyway, quite curious about it all.

Xian

UPS didn't leave my cards as requested...something about needing me to
sign in person...how annoying.
